factCards.text: The Masoretes of Tiberias added vowel and cantillation marks to the consonantal Hebrew text between roughly the seventh and tenth centuries CE.

The Pali Canon is traditionally said to have been committed to writing in Sri Lanka in the first century BCE. The date rests on later chronicle evidence rather than contemporary documents, so it is recorded here as tradition, not as settled fact.
factCards.sourceTitle: Mahavamsa, Sinhalese chronicle (as discussed in Britannica, 'Pali canon')

factCards.text: The Guru Granth Sahib is written in Gurmukhi script and includes compositions by Sikh Gurus alongside Hindu and Muslim devotional poets.
